description: Returns the recent change history for a live Trident document. Each entry shows who made the change, what was changed, and when. Useful for understanding what edits have been made by AI agents or human collaborators. Requires a valid access token.

limit.description: Optional: Maximum number of entries to return (default 100, max 500)

since.description: Optional: Unix timestamp in milliseconds — only return changes after this time

token.description: Access token for this document. The document ID is embedded in the token.

name: get_recent_changes
